topics.title: EU and UK Impose First Joint Cyber Sanctions on Russia
topics.latest_developments: The European Union and United Kingdom imposed their first joint cyber sanctions on July 13, 2026, the EU listing nine individuals and four entities and the UK naming 24, targeting GRU military intelligence and a network of hackers, hacktivists, and front companies, while the US Treasury separately sanctioned First VPN Service and its Ukrainian administrator for aiding ransomware groups.
topics.summary: The sanctions follow allied attribution of FSB Center 16 sabotage against Poland's energy and water-treatment systems. Critical-infrastructure operators should harden internet-facing routers per CISA's companion advisory AA26-194a.

sources.title: Russia's FSB blamed for Poland grid attack as UK and EU impose first joint cyber sanctions
EU sanctions Russian GRU military hackers over cyberattacks
EU and UK blacklist Russia's cyber operators over efforts to destabilize Europe
VPN service favored by ransomware groups is sanctioned by US

topics.title: License-Plate Readers and Drone Surveillance
topics.latest_developments: The Los Angeles Police Department let its Flock license-plate-reader contract expire after the system repeatedly flagged innocent drivers' cars as stolen and led officers to pull them over, as Wired reported a leak of hours of San Francisco Police Department Skydio drone footage and Meta filed a patent for an AI that listens all day and logs a person's inferred emotions.
topics.summary: Automated plate readers, police drones, and always-listening AI each expand routine mass surveillance and its error rate. Civil-liberties advocates press for warrant requirements and tighter retention limits.

sources.title: LAPD Regularly Pulled Over Innocent People Because License Plate Readers Flagged Their Cars As Stolen
A Leak of San Francisco Police Drone Footage Exposes the New Reality of Urban Surveillance
Meta Files Patent for AI That Can Listen All Day and Track How You're Feeling

topics.title: CrashStealer macOS Infostealer
topics.latest_developments: Jamf Threat Labs flagged CrashStealer, a native C++ macOS stealer that poses as Apple's crash-reporting tool and rides a notarized dropper past Gatekeeper, validating the victim's login password locally before harvesting credentials, keychain data, and crypto wallets.
topics.summary: CrashStealer breaks from the usual AppleScript and Objective-C stealers by compiling in C++ and abusing Apple notarization. Mac users should avoid crash-reporter lookalikes and verify software provenance before installing.

sources.title: New CrashStealer malware poses as Apple crash reporting tool
CrashStealer macOS Malware Uses Notarized Dropper to Pass Gatekeeper Checks

topics.title: Jscrambler npm and ModHeader Extension Compromises
topics.latest_developments: Jscrambler disclosed that a threat actor published a malicious infostealer build of its npm package, downloaded nearly 1,500 times, the same day Google and Microsoft pulled ModHeader—a header-editing extension with 1.6 million Chrome and Edge installs—after researchers found a dormant hidden browsing-history collector inside the official store version.
topics.summary: Both incidents put attacker code inside widely trusted developer and browser tools. Teams should audit dependency and extension inventories, pin versions, and revoke exposed credentials.

sources.title: Hackers backdoor Jscrambler npm package with infostealer malware
Google and Microsoft Pull ModHeader With 1.6 Million Installs After Dormant Collector Found

topics.title: Attackers Weaponize AI for Intrusions
topics.latest_developments: Researchers caught an unknown actor running a vibe-coded, AI-generated PowerShell script that enumerated Active Directory—finding domain controllers, mapping users and computers, and exporting an AD_Report.html summary—while the SANS Internet Storm Center observed internet-wide scanning for exposed MCP servers and AI-assistant credentials.
topics.summary: Intruders now use large language models to write reconnaissance tooling and hunt for AI infrastructure keys. Defenders should monitor for anomalous PowerShell enumeration and lock down MCP endpoints and stored assistant credentials.

sources.title: Attacker Uses Suspected AI-Generated PowerShell Script to Map Active Directory
Someone Is Scanning for Your MCP Servers and AI Assistant Credentials

topics.title: Entra ID Passkeys and OAuth Client-ID Spoofing
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft made passkeys the default sign-in method in Entra ID and rolled out a new SMS and voice authentication model on July 13, 2026, the same day Help Net Security detailed attackers spoofing the OAuth client_id to log account-enumeration probes as a familiar application and slip past Entra ID sign-in telemetry.
topics.summary: Entra ID's passkey default pushes tenants toward phishing-resistant login, while the client_id spoofing trick lets attackers enumerate valid accounts without tripping the usual logs. Administrators should enforce passkeys and scrutinize sign-in logs for unfamiliar application IDs.

sources.title: Microsoft Entra ID security updates: Passkeys are the default authentication method in Entra ID
Fake OAuth client IDs are helping attackers slip past sign-in logs

business_politics.title: Iran Conflict Roils Global Markets
business_politics.latest_developments: Oil futures jumped nearly 10% past $80 a barrel, Treasury yields rose, gold slid below $4,000, and U.S. and Asian tech shares tumbled Monday as the reinstated blockade and Iran's renewed Hormuz closure drove investors into risk-off positions.
business_politics.summary: President Trump revived a U.S. naval blockade of Iran and vowed a 20% fee on ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz; the resulting oil surge and Treasury sell-off rippled across global markets as chipmakers led equities lower.

business_politics.title: Fed's Waller Flags Rate-Hike Risk
business_politics.latest_developments: Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller warned Monday that another 'hot' inflation reading could push the central bank to raise interest rates, a hawkish turn as energy prices climb.
business_politics.summary: Christopher Waller, a Federal Reserve governor, said a further elevated inflation reading may prompt the Fed to tighten policy, signaling rate-hike risk just as the U.S.-Iran conflict lifts oil prices.

sources.title: Top Fed official warns 'hot' inflation could trigger rate rise

business.title: Astrobotic Sale to Voyager Completed
business.latest_developments: Pittsburgh's Astrobotic Technology completed its sale to Colorado-based Voyager Technologies, the Post-Gazette reported Monday.
business.summary: Astrobotic Technology, the Pittsburgh company that builds lunar landers and space robotics, finished its acquisition by Voyager Technologies of Colorado, folding a marquee local space startup into a larger aerospace firm.

sources.title: Astrobotic sale to Colorado's Voyager is complete

business.title: Skill-Games Tax Left in Limbo
business.latest_developments: Pennsylvania's newly passed state budget skipped any regulation of skill games, leaving Pittsburgh's tax on the machines unresolved, TribLive reported Monday.
business.summary: Pennsylvania lawmakers approved a budget this weekend without addressing how to regulate skill games, the slot-like machines in bars and stores, leaving the City of Pittsburgh's tax on them in legal limbo.

sources.title: Pittsburgh tax on skill games left in limbo after state budget defers regulation

business.title: Sheetz Expands in Greater Cincinnati
business.latest_developments: Altoona-based Sheetz opened its newest store, deepening its push into the Greater Cincinnati market.
business.summary: Sheetz, the family-owned convenience-store chain based in Altoona, opened another location in the Greater Cincinnati region as it extends its footprint into Ohio.

sources.title: Sheetz expands further into Greater Cincinnati with newest store opening

around_town.title: County Council May Keep Spending Cap
around_town.latest_developments: In a sudden reversal, Allegheny County Council could scrap its own plan to ask voters to remove the council's discretionary spending cap, the Post-Gazette reported Monday.
around_town.summary: Allegheny County Council had advanced a ballot referendum to lift the cap on its discretionary spending; members now signal they may abandon the measure before it reaches voters.

sources.title: In a sudden reversal, County Council could scuttle a plan to remove its own spending cap

around_town.title: Parkway East Closure Eases Into Workweek
around_town.latest_developments: The first full weekday of the Parkway East (I-376) closure brought no major traffic problems, and Pittsburgh Water halted several of its own construction projects to keep detour routes clear.
around_town.summary: PennDOT's 25-day closure of the Parkway East for the Commercial Street Bridge replacement, routing roughly 100,000 daily drivers onto detours through Point Breeze and Swissvale, moved through its first workday smoothly as Pittsburgh Water paused nearby construction.

sources.title: No major traffic problems on first weekday Parkway East closure

around_town.title: Turtle Creek Gorge Land Preserved
around_town.latest_developments: A 23-acre tract of wooded land along the Turtle Creek gorge near Trafford will be permanently preserved after its purchase, TribLive reported Monday.
around_town.summary: Conservation of 23 acres along the Westmoreland Heritage Trail near Trafford expands protected habitat in the Turtle Creek gorge, adding to the trail's green corridor in Westmoreland County.

sources.title: Westmoreland Heritage Trail land acquisition expands protected habitat

team_usa.title: Revolution Extend Matt Turner's Loan
team_usa.latest_developments: The New England Revolution extended the loan of U.S. men's national team goalkeeper Matt Turner from Lyon through the end of 2026, the club announced Monday.
